notes: Paper (Blum, D'Agnolo, Lisanti, Safdi 2014, arXiv:1401.6460) derives a BBN constraint on axion DM coupling to QCD from 4He abundance (delta Yp/Yp < 10%). The bound is stated in text as fa*ma > 1.3e-9 GeV^2 for ma > 1e-16 eV, and fa*ma > 1.8e-9 GeV^2 * (ma/1e-16 eV)^(3/4) for ma << 1e-16 eV. Converted to the g_d = (2.4e-16 e cm)/fa plane of Fig. 1 using 1 e cm = 1.5346e13 GeV^-1, giving g_d < 2.83e-3 * ma[eV] GeV^-2 (high-mass regime) and g_d < 2.05e-15 * ma[eV]^(1/4) GeV^-2 (ultra-light regime). Points derived analytically from these text formulas, not digitized from figure. Uses cosmological mean DM density (not local halo density), so dm_density_assumed set to null; this is a cosmological bound, not a haloscope. Paper notes ~40% theory uncertainty on g_d expression.
